[size=5][b]Goat Replacement:[/b] [/size][size=4]Better Goat colors that replace the yellow coloring of the original goats and baby goats. [/size]

[size=3]I didn't like the appearance of the original goats with the yellow coloring, so this mod changes the goat coloring to brown with white details. [/size]

Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]Locate the Stardew Valley files. (If you downloaded it through steam it should be under C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley)[/size]

[*][size=3]Go into the StardewValley\Content\Animals folder and make a backup of the original files Gaot.xnb and Babygoat.xnb so that you can revert back to the original if needed.[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract the files from the downloaded file[/size]
[*][size=3]Place the downloaded goat.xnb and babygoat.xnb into the file directory listed above. [/size]
[/list]
(I've also posted a version of the mod on the Stardew Valley mod thread, and it can be found here: [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/goat-replacement.111603/]Link[/url] )

Downloads.Description: Fixes a small mistake on the shadow for the baby goat facing forward not being transparent
